fixes: One synchronous mutation lock shared by evolve/freeze/revert until verified readback completes
Abort reads and writes on keyed personality/account/role/workspace changes; ignore late responses even if a transport ignores abort
Latest refresh replaces earlier reads; language changes do not reset request ownership
HTTP and business rejection, malformed top-level snapshots and unconfirmed receipts cannot become success
Freeze and revert require matching readback state; evolved:false produces an informational result instead of success
Failed reads show an inline retry path and disable mutations until a valid snapshot is loaded
Evolution socket events are checked against personality, user and organization; events during mutation readback trigger a later refresh
Radar axes share one geometry calculation; historical vectors use one reverse traversal and are memoized per snapshot
limitations: Client abort does not undo a server write already accepted.
Snapshot checks cover identity, history container and config primitives used directly by this component, not an exhaustive schema validator.
React tests mount the component with simulated transport; no native client or real model calls were tested.
No full-suite rerun or backend rebuild for this frontend-only batch.
